About AutoFi
AutoFi is the leading provider of digital commerce technology that powers the sales and finance experiences for the most innovative brands and dealers in automotive. The AutoFi platform enables a more transactional buying experience with $4B in funded loans processed through AutoFi annually. AutoFi’s dynamic selling platform empowers dealers to sell vehicles more efficiently and profitably, both online and in the showroom. We are funded for years of future growth and backed by investors including Crosslink Capital, Santander Holdings USA, SVB Financial Group, Ford, BMW iVentures and JP Morgan Chase.

Our team is diverse - spread out across the U.S. and Canada, we have backgrounds from finance and technology as well as deep experience in all areas of the auto space. We’re empathetic, gritty, curious, and humble owners of this business and are supported by some of the biggest names in the auto and financial industries as commercial partners. We’ve never been more excited about the opportunity in front of us to help transition the auto industry from offline to online. If changing a trillion-dollar industry sounds exciting, we’d love to hear from you.

For more information, visit www.autofi.com.

About the Role

AutoFi is seeking a Captivating Change Management Advisor (CMA) who easily builds rapport, has high energy and a passion to influence to change their performance by using AutoFi's sales platform, and train the dealership staff, specifically the managers know how to use AutoFi and incorporate AutoFi into their daily routine. This requires working in person, side by side with Finance Managers, Sales Managers, GSMs, and GMs while they work car deals. This role will sit on a sales desk with the managers of the dealership and show them how to sell cars using AutoFI. This role requires you to be comfortable presenting numbers to customers, negotiating the terms of a car deal, overcoming objections, closing car deals, and presenting F&I products. Candidates need to be able to easily and quickly build relationships with all dealership employees. 

The ideal candidate is someone who is an experienced automotive retail professional who understands dealership operations, enjoys developing others, can influence people without direct authority, and takes ownership of difficult situations.

70% travel In person/ 3 weeks a month, (Mon-Fri) away from home travel required across the US

  • Ensure the dealer’s AutoFi usage is at least 70%

    About the Role
    Reporting to the Manager, Partner Support Services, the Dealer Partner Support Specialist is responsible for supporting the ongoing operational health, configuration, and functionality of AutoFi's products and services for our Dealership and Dealer Group partners. Acting as a key point of contact and subject matter expert following implementation, this role responds to partner inquiries, manages program adjustments, troubleshoots issues, and works collaboratively with internal teams and external vendors to ensure programs function as intended and continue to meet evolving business needs.

    Partner Support Services plays a key role in operating as the first line of support for all of AutoFi’s clientele. They triage and prioritize all incoming requests, resolve general inquiries, make program settings adjustments, work with vendors to align on integrated functionality, and ensure Clients/Partners are able to connect with the appropriate resources.  They monitor expected program functionality, proactively taking steps to resolve potential gaps and capitalize on enhancement opportunities.

    An ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented, resourceful problem solver who combines strong customer service skills with technical aptitude and a commitment to accuracy.  They will be comfortable managing competing priorities, investigating issues independently, and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a fast paced environment.  Success in this role requires accountability, sound judgement, adaptability and a proactive approach to maintaining program health and delivering an exceptional partner experience.  This position includes occasional scheduled evening and weekend support coverage to accommodate Dealerships operating hours.  Each member of our team is challenged to contribute in a variety of capacities across the entire organization and show their individual strengths, from product to customer experience.

  • Participate in and contribute to a collaborative, accountable team environment with a culture of open communication through knowledge sharing, constructive feedback, and a willingness to support shared priorities.
  • Develop and maintain proficiency in AutoFi's product suite, integration capabilities, and Dealer Partner use cases, providing informed recommendations to optimize program configurations and functionality.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for Dealer Partners, responding to inquiries, resolving issues, and managing requests professionally and efficiently in accordance with expected service levels.
  • Maintain and optimize Dealer Partner program settings, configurations, features, and integrations, including working with JSON, XML, CSS, and Regex as needed.
  • Independently validate completed work to ensure configuration changes are accurate, complete, and functioning as intended before considering requests resolved.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting of configuration, integration, and functional issues as needed to identify root causes, resolve common problems, and escalate more complex issues with appropriate supporting details.
  • Collaborate with Account Management, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams, as well as external vendors, to coordinate solutions and support evolving Dealer Partner needs.
  • Proactively monitor Dealer Partner programs to identify functional anomalies, configuration gaps, and opportunities to improve program performance and reliability.
  • Manage a concurrent workload of approximately 20-30 assigned requests through to resolution against expected SLAs, effectively balancing competing priorities, maintaining accurate case documentation, clear stakeholder communication, and timely follow-up through phone, email and text, leveraging specific internal and vendor communications platforms where applicable.
  • Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve support processes, contributing to the development of standardized procedures, documentation, and best practices, inclusive of the nuances, pros and cons of various approaches.
  • Support first-line inquiries across AutoFi's broader Partner ecosystem as needed through phone, chat and email, leveraging available tools, including AI-assisted solutions, to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Participate in scheduled after-hours support coverage, including a minimum of one Saturday per month.

  • 2-3 years experience working in customer support, technical support, account management or a related customer-facing role, preferably within the SaaS environment.  
  • Strong attention to detail, with a demonstrated ability to accurately execute, validate and document work
    Analytical and critical thinking skills, including the ability to independently investigate issues, troubleshoot basic technical problems, and determine when escalation is appropriate.
  • Excellent written/verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and navigate challenging customer interactions
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing requests and meet established service expectations
  • Technical aptitude and comfort working with software configurations, system settings, integrated applications and AI Agents
  • A proactive, accountable approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams
  • Flexibility to participate in scheduled evening and weekend coverage including a minimum of one Saturday per month
  • Familiarity with automotive dealership operations, business models, and personnel responsibilities strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, JSON, XML, HTML, CSS, and Regex strongly preferred
  • Experience using Salesforce, Jira, Postman, or similar CRM, case management, and API troubleshooting tools preferred.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve productivity, troubleshooting, or customer support workflows preferred.

    About the Role 

    Reporting into the Manager, Dealer Implementations, the Implementations Configuration Specialist is responsible for the accurate, timely configuration and integration of AutoFi's products to support successful Dealer Partner launches, including new implementations and product expansions for existing partners.  In this role, you will work closely with Dealer Onboarding Specialists, internal stakeholders, and third-party vendors, translate Dealer Partner requirements into functional technical configurations, troubleshoot issues, and ensure assigned deliverables meet established quality standards and launch timelines.

    Implementation Services is devoted to receiving and caring for net-new Dealer Partners as well as product upsells to existing Dealer Partners that originate through the Sales organization.  They work with Dealers and their representatives to ensure that all aspects of their Program with AutoFi are appropriately configured for a successful launch, from basic configurations/feature enablement all the way through to complex integrations and related testing.  They are subject matter experts with a deep understanding of how to use, speak to and configure AutoFi’s product suite to best meet our Dealer Partner’s requirements.

    An ideal candidate will have strong technical aptitude, attention to detail, independent problem-solving, and the ability to manage a high volume of concurrent implementations with competing priorities. You will take ownership of your work from initial configuration through testing, launch readiness, and completion of required post-launch activities.  As part of Implementation Services, you will develop deep expertise in AutoFi's product suite and integrations, helping ensure Dealer Partners are configured to successfully adopt and use our solutions.

    ","id":"93a40410-0021-481f-ba30-8d5cda245309","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"
  • Participate in and contribute to a collaborative, accountable team environment with a culture of open communication through knowledge sharing, constructive feedback, and a willingness to support shared priorities.
  • Own the technical configuration and integration of AutoFi's products for assigned Dealer Partner implementations, ensuring requirements are accurately translated into functional, launch-ready solutions.
  • Manage a concurrent workload of approximately 13–20 implementations, effectively balancing competing priorities, dependencies, and deadlines to meet committed launch timelines.
  • Collaborate with Dealer Onboarding Specialists and internal stakeholders to establish achievable launch timelines, identify dependencies, and ensure assigned configuration and integration activities are completed on schedule.
  • Serve as a technical point of contact for Dealer Partners, their representatives, and third-party vendors to gather requirements, provide configuration guidance, troubleshoot issues, and resolve implementation blockers.
  • Manage assigned technical implementation needs through resolution, maintaining accurate case documentation, clear stakeholder communication, and timely follow-up through phone, email and text, leveraging specific internal and vendor communications platforms where applicable.
  • Apply and validate product configurations and integrations using APIs, JSON, XML, HTML, CSS, and other relevant technologies to meet Dealer Partner requirements.
  • Independently review and test completed configurations and integrations for accuracy, completeness, and expected functionality before transitioning work to dedicated Quality Assurance (QA) resources for formal validation.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting of configuration and integration issues, identifying potential root causes, implementing appropriate corrections, and escalating more complex issues when necessary.
  • Partner with QA resources to investigate and resolve identified defects, ensuring outstanding issues are addressed and configurations meet established launch-readiness requirements.
  • Proactively communicate implementation progress, risks, delays, and capacity constraints, escalating concerns early and taking ownership of assigned deliverables through completion.
  • Complete required post-launch configuration adjustments, troubleshooting, documentation, and other follow-up activities accurately and within established timelines.
  • Develop and maintain proficiency in AutoFi's product suite, integration capabilities, and Dealer Partner use cases, providing informed recommendations to optimize program configurations and functionality.
  • Maintain accurate implementation records, configuration specifications, and testing documentation while contributing to process improvements, repeatable best practices, and a collaborative team environment.

  • Excellent organizational, time management, and prioritization skills, with demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of concurrent assignments and competing deadlines.
  • Ability to contribute to realistic implementation timelines, identify risks and dependencies, and consistently deliver on commitments.
  • Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to work independently, proactively communicate progress and challenges, and recognize when escalation or additional support is required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to gather requirements, explain technical concepts, and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and requirements while maintaining accuracy, productivity, and a high standard of work.

    AutoFi is the leading provider of digital commerce technology that powers the sales and finance experiences for the most innovative brands and dealers in automotive.     Product Strategy & Leadership
     
    Own and drive product vision, strategy, and roadmaps for key areas of AutoFi's automotive retailing and financing platform.
    Lead complex, high-impact product initiatives spanning dealerships, lenders, consumers, and technology partners.
    Identify market opportunities, emerging technologies, and competitive advantages within automotive FinTech and digital retailing.
    Translate business objectives, customer needs, and industry trends into actionable product strategies.
    Influence product direction and cross-functional priorities through strong communication, data, and business judgment.
    Operate as a senior individual contributor, providing thought leadership and mentorship across the Product organization.
     
    Automotive Domain Expertise

    Leverage deep experience in one or more of the following automotive software domains:
    Automotive Desking and Deal Structuring
    Indirect Auto Lending and Loan Origination
    Automotive Finance & Insurance (F&I)
    Vehicle Leasing, Residual Values, and Payment Calculations
    Digital Retailing and Automotive eCommerce
    Dealer Management Systems (DMS) and Third-Party Integrations
    Understand dealership workflows, lender requirements, compliance considerations, and consumer purchasing experiences.
    Partner with dealership customers, lenders, and internal stakeholders to identify friction points and develop scalable solutions.
    Build products that simplify complex automotive transactions while improving dealer efficiency, consumer conversion, and financing outcomes.
     
    AI-First Product Management

    Use AI tools daily to improve productivity, accelerate product development, and make better-informed decisions.
    Integrate AI into everyday product management workflows, including customer research, competitive analysis, requirements development, data analysis, and prototyping.
    Identify opportunities to embed AI, automation, and intelligent decision-making into AutoFi's product offerings.
    Collaborate with Engineering and Design to explore AI-powered features that create meaningful customer and business value.
    Continuously experiment with emerging AI technologies and champion practical AI adoption across the organization.
     
    Product Execution & Delivery

    Lead end-to-end product development, from discovery and business case development through launch and iteration.
    Work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership to deliver high-quality solutions.
    Develop clear product requirements, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
    Make thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, quality, technical complexity, and business impact.
    Define and monitor KPIs, including adoption, conversion, transaction completion, revenue impact, and customer satisfaction.
    Use data, customer feedback, and experimentation to continuously optimize product performance.
